posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina wished director Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid rift rumours, while sharing pregnancy updates and romantic Rajasthan vacation moments with Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit made history as the first Indian musician to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden on his AURA tour, and dropped behind-the-scenes pics from Sardaar Ji 3 with Neeru Bajwa.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia turned heads at Cannes 2026 with multiple red carpet appearances and is confirmed to join Tumbbad 2 in a powerful role alongside her YRF spy film Alpha.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirmed six months of filming remain for SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu, and is reportedly in talks for the next James Bond film.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller King is confirmed for a Christmas 2026 release on December 24, facing a mega box office clash with Avengers: Doomsday and Dune 3.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is set to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film, with shooting expected to begin from October-November 2026.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha made her relationship with screenwriter Rahul Mody official and continues to reign as one of India's most-followed Instagram stars after the blockbuster Stree 2.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's Raka and SRK's King due to her pregnancy, while Sai Pallavi has replaced her in Kalki 2.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer is reportedly being considered for the Shaktimaan role, while his Dhurandhar 2 has sold 18 million tickets on BookMyShow, becoming one of 2026's biggest Bollywood hits.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with multiple show-stopping looks including a sapphire gown and feathered cape, marking her 24th year at the festival with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika presented at the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Black Panther's Winston Duke, and her romantic track Tujhko from Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor just dropped.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha unveiled the fierce trailer for Maa Inti Bangaaram, showcasing her action-packed avatar as a ruthless daughter-in-law. The film releases June 19, 2026.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's collaboration with director Basil Joseph is confirmed (not Shaktimaan), and the Pushpa star met RCB's Venkatesh Iyer after an IPL 2026 match in Hyderabad.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi hits $100K in North American pre-sales within hours ahead of its June 4 release, while he apologized for hilariously calling Jasprit Bumrah a 'footballer' at a promo event.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon shoot with Prashanth Neel was paused again for a look rework, as the superstar lines up four massive films including War 2 and Devara 2.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is on a promotional blitz for Peddi alongside Ram Charan, with the Hellallallo song going viral, and she joined cricketer Pat Cummins at a New Balance event in Delhi.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic drama Chand Mera Dil crossed ₹18 crore worldwide in just 4 days, though her Bharatnatyam dance sequence sparked debate online.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shut down rumors about requesting cuts in her film Toxic, calling the claims 'absolute nonsense,' and is set to headline a Madhubala biopic directed by Jasmeet K. Reen.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's Krrish 4 remains stuck in limbo over a VFX disagreement, while War 2 with Jr NTR gets a massive ₹100 crore offer for Telugu theatrical rights.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with David Dhawan has been postponed to June 12, with an emotional trailer launch where his father called him 'every parent's dream son.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal is gearing up for her 2026 US concert tour including The Unstoppable Tour dates in Boston and the All Hearts Tour, continuing her reign as Bollywood's most beloved playback singer.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed a massive live concert in Bhopal for Peddi Ki Aawaz with Ram Charan, and revealed his collaboration with Hans Zimmer on the ₹4,000 crore Ramayana soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay turned 51 on May 25 as his final film Jana Nayagan still awaits CBFC certification, with the producer promising a release date announcement soon.
